In these two varsas of Dhataki and Mahavira, where time affords delight to the inhabitants who are freed from sickness and decay. There is a Nyagrodha-tree (Fisucus-indica) on this insular continent which is a favourite resort of Brahmā and where he lives worshipped by the celestials and Asuras. Pushkara is encircled by Syaduka ocean (sea of fresh water) which is of equal extent with the island.

In this way the seven insular continents are encircled by seven seas and each ocean and island is twice the dimension of that which precedes it. The water, in all these oceans, remains the same at all seasons and never increases or diminishes. Like the water in a cauldron, which expands in consequence of heat, the waters of the oceans swell with the increase of the moon, O foremost of Munis. Except in the light and dark fortnights the waters neither increase nor decrease. O great Muni, the rise and fall of the waters is five hundred and ten inches. In this island of Pushkara, O Brahman, foods are produced spontaneously and people there enjoy viands of various flavours.

Beyond the sea of fresh water, there is the land of gold which is twice its extent where no living beings dwell. Beyond that is the mountain Lokaloka which is a ten thousand yojanas in height and as many in breadth. The other side of the mountain is enshrouded with perpetual darkness which again is encircled by the shell of egg.

Such, O Maitreya, is the earth with all its continents, mountains and oceans and exterior shell. The extent of the earth is five hundred millions. It is the mother and nurse of beings, the foremost of all elements and the stay of all the worlds.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
विस्तार एष कथितः पृथिव्या भवतो मया
सप्ततिस्तु सहस्राणि द्विजोच्छ्रायोपि कथ्यते ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
vistara esha kathitah prithivya bhavato maya
saptatistu sahasrani dvijochchhrayopi kathyate ||

verses.sa:
दशसाहस्रमेकैकं पातालं मुनिसत्तम
अतलं वितलं चैव नितलं च गभस्तिमत्
महाख्यं सुतलं चाग्र्यं पातालं चापि सप्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
dashasahasramekaikam patalam munisattama
atalam vitalam chaiva nitalam cha gabhastimat
mahakhyam sutalam chagryam patalam chapi saptamam ||

verses.sa:
शुक्लाकृष्णारुणाः पीताः शर्कराः शैलकांचनाः
भूमयो यत्र मैत्रेय वरप्रासादमंडिताः ॥
verses.rom:
shuklakrishnarunah pitah sharkarah shailakamchanah
bhumayo yatra maitreya varaprasadamamditah ||

verses.sa:
तेषु दानवदैतेया यक्षाश्च शतशस्तथा
निवसन्ति महानागजातयश्च महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
teshu danavadaiteya yakshashcha shatashastatha
nivasanti mahanagajatayashcha mahamune ||

verses.sa:
स्वर्लोकादपि रम्याणि पातालानीति नारदः
प्राह स्वर्गसदां मध्ये पातालाभ्यागतो दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
svarlokadapi ramyani patalaniti naradah
praha svargasadam madhye patalabhyagato divi ||

verses.sa:
आह्लादकारिणः शुभ्रा मणयो यत्र सुप्रभाः
नागाभरणभूषासु पातालं केन तत्समम् ॥
verses.rom:
ahladakarinah shubhra manayo yatra suprabhah
nagabharanabhushasu patalam kena tatsamam ||

verses.sa:
दैत्यदानवकन्याभिरितश्चेतश्च शोभिते
पाताले कस्य न प्रीतिर्विमुक्तस्यापि जायते ॥
verses.rom:
daityadanavakanyabhiritashchetashcha shobhite
patale kasya na pritirvimuktasyapi jayate ||

verses.sa:
दिवार्करश्मयो यत्र प्रभां तन्वन्ति नातपम्
शशिरश्मिर्न शीताय निशि द्योताय केवलम् ॥
verses.rom:
divarkarashmayo yatra prabham tanvanti natapam
shashirashmirna shitaya nishi dyotaya kevalam ||

verses.sa:
भक्ष्यभोज्यमहापानमुदितैरपि भोगिभिः
यत्र न ज्ञायते कालो गतोपि दनुजादिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
bhakshyabhojyamahapanamuditairapi bhogibhih
yatra na jnayate kalo gatopi danujadibhih ||

verses.sa:
वनानि नद्यो रम्याणि सरांसि कमलाकराः
पुंस्कोकिलाभिलापाश्च मनोज्ञान्यम्बराणि च ॥
verses.rom:
vanani nadyo ramyani saramsi kamalakarah
pumskokilabhilapashcha manojnanyambarani cha ||

verses.sa:
भूषणान्यतिशुभ्राणि गन्धाढ्यं चानुलेपनम्
वीणावेणुमृदंगानां स्वनैरापूरितानि च ॥
verses.rom:
bhushananyatishubhrani gandhadhyam chanulepanam
vinavenumridamganam svanairapuritani cha ||

verses.sa:
एतान्यन्यानि चोदारभाग्यभोग्यानि दानवैः
दैत्योरगैश्च भुज्यन्ते पातालान्तरगोचरैः ॥
verses.rom:
etanyanyani chodarabhagyabhogyani danavaih
daityoragaishcha bhujyante patalantaragocharaih ||

verses.sa:
पातालानामधश्चास्ते विष्णोर्या तामसी तनुः
शेषाख्या यद्गुणान्वक्तुं न शक्ता दैत्यदानवाः ॥
verses.rom:
patalanamadhashchaste vishnorya tamasi tanuh
sheshakhya yadgunanvaktum na shakta daityadanavah ||

verses.sa:
योनन्तः पठ्यते सिद्धैर्दैवो देवर्षिपूजितः
स सहस्रशिरा व्यक्तस्वस्तिकामलभूषणः ॥
verses.rom:
yonantah pathyate siddhairdaivo devarshipujitah
sa sahasrashira vyaktasvastikamalabhushanah ||

verses.sa:
फणामणिसहस्रेण यः स विद्योतयन्दिशः
सर्वान्करोति निर्वीर्यान् हिताय जगतोऽसुरान् ॥
verses.rom:
phanamanisahasrena yah sa vidyotayandishah
sarvankaroti nirviryan hitaya jagato'suran ||

verses.sa:
मदाघूर्णितनेत्रोसौ यः सदैवैककुण्डलः
किरीटी स्रग्धरो भाति साग्निः श्वेत इवाचलः ॥
verses.rom:
madaghurnitanetrosau yah sadaivaikakundalah
kiriti sragdharo bhati sagnih shveta ivachalah ||

verses.sa:
नीलवासा मदोत्सिक्तः श्वेतहारोपशोभितः
साभ्रगङ्गाप्रवाहोसौ कैलासाद्रिरिवापरः ॥
verses.rom:
nilavasa madotsiktah shvetaharopashobhitah
sabhragangapravahosau kailasadririvaparah ||

verses.sa:
लाङ्गलासक्तहस्ताग्रो बिभ्रन्मुसलमुत्तमम्
उपास्यते स्वयं कान्त्या यो वारुण्या च मूर्त्तया ॥
verses.rom:
langalasaktahastagro bibhranmusalamuttamam
upasyate svayam kantya yo varunya cha murttaya ||

verses.sa:
कल्पान्ते यस्य वक्त्रेभ्यो विषानलशिखोज्ज्वलः
संकर्षणात्मको रुद्रो निष्क्रम्यात्ति जगत्त्रयम् ॥
verses.rom:
kalpante yasya vaktrebhyo vishanalashikhojjvalah
samkarshanatmako rudro nishkramyatti jagattrayam ||

verses.sa:
स बिभ्रच्छेखरीभूतमशेषं क्षितिमण्डलम्
आस्ते पातालमूलस्थः शेषोऽशेषसुरार्चितः ॥
verses.rom:
sa bibhrachchhekharibhutamashesham kshitimandalam
aste patalamulasthah shesho'sheshasurarchitah ||

verses.sa:
तस्य वीर्यं प्रभावश्च स्वरूपं रूपमेव च
न हि वर्णयितुं शक्यं ज्ञातुं च त्रिदशैरपि ॥
verses.rom:
tasya viryam prabhavashcha svarupam rupameva cha
na hi varnayitum shakyam jnatum cha tridashairapi ||

verses.sa:
यस्यैषा सकला पृथ्वी फणामणिशिखारुणा
आस्ते कुसुममालेव कस्तद्वीर्यं वदिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
yasyaisha sakala prithvi phanamanishikharuna
aste kusumamaleva kastadviryam vadishyati ||

verses.sa:
यदा विजृम्भतेनन्तो मदाघूर्णितलोचनः
तदा चलति भूरेषा साब्धितोया सकानना ॥
verses.rom:
yada vijrimbhatenanto madaghurnitalochanah
tada chalati bhuresha sabdhitoya sakanana ||

verses.sa:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसः सिद्धाः किन्नरोरगचारणाः
नान्तं गुणानां गच्छन्ति तेनानन्तोयमव्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
gandharvapsarasah siddhah kinnaroragacharanah
nantam gunanam gachchhanti tenanantoyamavyayah ||

verses.sa:
यस्य नागवधूहस्तैर्लगितं हरिचन्दनम्
मुहुः श्वासानिलापास्तं याति दिक्क्षोदवासताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya nagavadhuhastairlagitam harichandanam
muhuh shvasanilapastam yati dikkshodavasatam ||

verses.sa:
यमाराध्य पूराणर्षिर्गर्गो ज्योतींषि तत्त्वतः
ज्ञातवान्सकलं चैव निमित्तपठितं फलम् ॥
verses.rom:
yamaradhya puranarshirgargo jyotimshi tattvatah
jnatavansakalam chaiva nimittapathitam phalam ||

verses.sa:
तेनेयं नागवर्येण शिरसा विधृता मही
बिभर्ति मालां लोकानां सदेवासुरमानुषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
teneyam nagavaryena shirasa vidhrita mahi
bibharti malam lokanam sadevasuramanusham ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे द्वितीयेंशो! पंचमोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane dvitiyemsho! pamchamo'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—The extent of the earth has been related to you by me. I have also said, O twice-born one, that the depth below the surface is seventy thousand yojanas. O foremost of Munis, each of the seven regions of Pātāla, extends over ten thousand yojanas. They are seven in number—namely Atala, Vitala, Nitala, Gavastimat, Malmtala, Sutala and Pātāla. Thus soil is severally white, black, purple, yellow, sandy, stony and of gold. They are adorned with numberless palaces in which reside Dānavas, Daityas, Yakshas and serpents by hundreds, O great Muni. Once on a time Nārada, after coming back to heaven from these regions, declared amongst the gods that Pātāla was much more charming than heaven. He exclaimed "What can be compared with Pātāla where Nāgas are adorned with beautiful and brilliant and pleasure-diffusing gems? This region is embellished with the daughters of Daityas and Dānavas. Who does not find delight in Pātāla? Even those who have retired from the world find delight therein. By day, the rays of the sun diffuse joy and not heat; by night the moon diffuses illumination and not cold. There the sons of Danu, always happy in the enjoyment of sweet foods and good wines, do not know how the time glides away. There are many charming forests, rivers and ponds abounding in lotuses and the skies are resonant with the Koil's song. Charming ornaments, fragrant perfumes, unguents, the sweet music of the lute, pipe and tabor are always enjoyed by the Daityas, Dānavas and serpents who dwell in the regions of Pātāla".

Below the regions of Patala there is a form of Vishnu called Sesha which is the outcome of the quality of darkness. The Daityas and Dānavas are incapable of counting the glories of this Deity. This is called Ananta by the ascetics of accomplished piety and is worshipped by the celestials and great sages. He has a thousand heads which are adorned with mystic lines. For the behoof of the world he illuminates all the quarters with the jewels on his thousand fangs and all the Asuras are disabled thereby. His eye rolls perpetually in consequence of inebriation; he has an excellent Kundala, a diadem on his head and a wreath upon each brow. He shined brilliantly like a white mountain topped with flame. He always wears a purple raiment, is always drunk, and adorned with a white necklace and appears like another Kailasha with sable clouds and the Ganges flowing. In one hand he holds a plough and in the other a mace. And he is being worshipped by the Goddess of wealth incarnate and Vāruni (the goodness of wine). At the time of great dissolution proceeds from his mouth the venomed fire in the form of Rudra, which devours the three Worlds. This Sesha form of the great God worshipped by celestials, is in Pātāla, bearing the entire world on his head like a diadem. Even the celestials are not capable of describing or knowing his strength, prowess, form and nature. Who can describe his prowess who holds the entire earth like a garland of flowers tinged with purple dye by the brilliance of jems on his crests?

When this Ananta, with his eyes rolling with intoxication, yawns the entire earth with its oceans, rivers and forests trembles; the Gandharvas, the Apsaras, Siddhas, Kinnaras, serpents and Charanas have not been able to find out the end of the qualities of his Being without end and hence he is called Ananta. The sandal paste, which is ground by the wives of the Nagas, is spread around by his breath and scatters fragrance all over the quarters.

Having worshipped him the ancient sage Garga obtained from him a knowledge of astronomy, of the planets and of the good and evil presaged by the aspects of the heavens.

The earth is supported by that Great Serpent, upon his head; and the earth again holds the garland of spheres along with men, celestials and Asuras.

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच
ततश्च नरका विप्र भुवोधः सलिलस्य च ।
पापिनो येषु पात्यन्ते ताञ्छृणुष्वमहामुने ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha
tatashcha naraka vipra bhuvodhah salilasya cha |
papino yeshu patyante tanchhrinushvamahamune ||

verses.sa:
रौरवः सूकरो रोधस्तालो विशसनस्तथा ।
महाज्वालस्तप्तकुम्भो लवणेथ विलोहितः ॥
verses.rom:
rauravah sukaro rodhastalo vishasanastatha |
mahajvalastaptakumbho lavanetha vilohitah ||

verses.sa:
रुधिराम्भो वैतरणिः क्रिमिशः क्रिमिभोजनः ।
असिपत्रवनं कृष्णो लालाभक्षश्च दारुणः ॥
verses.rom:
rudhirambho vaitaranih krimishah krimibhojanah |
asipatravanam krishno lalabhakshashcha darunah ||

verses.sa:
तथा पूयवहः पापो वह्निज्वालो ह्यधः शिराः ।
संदंशः कालसूत्रश्च तमश्चावीचिरेव च ॥
verses.rom:
tatha puyavahah papo vahnijvalo hyadhah shirah |
samdamshah kalasutrashcha tamashchavichireva cha ||

verses.sa:
श्वभोजनोथाप्रतिष्ठश्चाप्रचिश्च तथा परः ।
इत्येवमादयश्चान्ये नरका भृशदारुणाः ॥
verses.rom:
shvabhojanothapratishthashchaprachishcha tatha parah |
ityevamadayashchanye naraka bhrishadarunah ||

verses.sa:
यमस्य विषये घोराः शस्त्राग्निभयदायिनः ।
पतन्ति येषु पुरुषाः पापकर्मरतास्तु ये ॥
verses.rom:
yamasya vishaye ghorah shastragnibhayadayinah |
patanti yeshu purushah papakarmaratastu ye ||

verses.sa:
कूटसाक्षी तथासम्यक्पक्षपातेन यो वदेत् ।
यश्चान्यदनृतं वक्ति स नरो याति रौरवम् ॥
verses.rom:
kutasakshi tathasamyakpakshapatena yo vadet |
yashchanyadanritam vakti sa naro yati rauravam ||

verses.sa:
भ्रूणहा पुरहन्ता च गौघ्नश्च मुनिसत्तम ।
यान्ति ते नरकं रोधं यश्चोच्छ्वासनिरोधकः ॥
verses.rom:
bhrunaha purahanta cha gaughnashcha munisattama |
yanti te narakam rodham yashchochchhvasanirodhakah ||

verses.sa:
सुरापो ब्रह्महा हर्ता सुवर्णस्य च सूकरे ।
प्रयान्ति नरके यश्च तैः संसर्गमुपैति वै ॥
verses.rom:
surapo brahmaha harta suvarnasya cha sukare |
prayanti narake yashcha taih samsargamupaiti vai ||

verses.sa:
राजन्यवैश्यहन्ता च तथैव गुरुतल्पगः ।
तप्तकुण्डेस्वसृगामी हन्ति राजभटांश्च यः ॥
verses.rom:
rajanyavaishyahanta cha tathaiva gurutalpagah |
taptakundesvasrigami hanti rajabhatamshcha yah ||

verses.sa:
साध्वीविक्रयकृद्बन्धपालः केसरिविक्रयी ।
तप्तलोहे पतन्त्येते यश्च च भक्तं परित्यजेत् ॥
verses.rom:
sadhvivikrayakridbandhapalah kesarivikrayi |
taptalohe patantyete yashcha cha bhaktam parityajet ||

verses.sa:
स्नुषां सुतां चापि गत्वा महाज्वाले निपात्यते ।
अवमन्ता गुरूणां यो यश्चाक्रोष्टा नराधमः ॥
verses.rom:
snusham sutam chapi gatva mahajvale nipatyate |
avamanta gurunam yo yashchakroshta naradhamah ||

verses.sa:
वेददूषयितायश्च वेदविक्रयकश्च यः ।
अगम्यगामी यश्च स्यात्ते यान्ति लवणं द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
vedadushayitayashcha vedavikrayakashcha yah |
agamyagami yashcha syatte yanti lavanam dvija ||

verses.sa: चोरो विलोहे पतति मर्यादादूषकस्तथा ॥
verses.rom: choro vilohe patati maryadadushakastatha ||

verses.sa:
देवद्विजपितृद्वेष्टा रत्नदूषयिता च यः ।
स याति क्रिमिभक्षे वै क्रिमीशे च दुरिष्टकृत् ॥
verses.rom:
devadvijapitridveshta ratnadushayita cha yah |
sa yati krimibhakshe vai krimishe cha durishtakrit ||

verses.sa:
पितृदेवातिथींस्त्यक्त्वा पर्यश्नाति नराधमः ।
लालाभक्षे स यात्युग्रे शरकर्ता च वेधके ॥
verses.rom:
pitridevatithimstyaktva paryashnati naradhamah |
lalabhakshe sa yatyugre sharakarta cha vedhake ||

verses.sa:
करोति कर्णिनो यश्च यश्च खङ्गादिकृन्नरः ।
प्रयान्त्येते विशसने नरके भृशदरुणे ॥
verses.rom:
karoti karnino yashcha yashcha khangadikrinnarah |
prayantyete vishasane narake bhrishadarune ||

verses.sa:
असत्प्रतिगृहीता तु नरके यात्यधोमुखे ।
अयाज्ययाजकश्चैव तथा नक्षत्रसूचकः ॥
verses.rom:
asatpratigrihita tu narake yatyadhomukhe |
ayajyayajakashchaiva tatha nakshatrasuchakah ||

verses.sa: वेगी पूयवहे चैको याति मष्टान्नभुङ्गरः ॥
verses.rom: vegi puyavahe chaiko yati mashtannabhungarah ||

verses.sa:
लाक्षामासरसानां च तिलानां लवणस्य च ।
विक्रेता ब्रह्मणो याति तमेव नरकं द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
lakshamasarasanam cha tilanam lavanasya cha |
vikreta brahmano yati tameva narakam dvija ||

verses.sa:
मार्जारकुक्कुटच्छाग श्ववराहविहङ्गमान् ।
पोषयन्नरकं याति तमेव द्विजसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
marjarakukkutachchhaga shvavarahavihangaman |
poshayannarakam yati tameva dvijasattama ||

verses.sa:
रङ्गोपजीवी कैवर्तः कुम्डाशी गरदस्तथा ।
सूची माहिषकश्चैव पर्वकारी च यो द्विजः ॥
verses.rom:
rangopajivi kaivartah kumdashi garadastatha |
suchi mahishakashchaiva parvakari cha yo dvijah ||

verses.sa:
अगारदाही मित्रघ्नः शाकुनिर्ग्रमयाजकः ।
रुधिरान्धे पतन्त्येते सोमं विक्रीणते च ये ॥
verses.rom:
agaradahi mitraghnah shakunirgramayajakah |
rudhirandhe patantyete somam vikrinate cha ye ||

verses.sa: मखहा ग्रामहन्ता च याति वैतरणीं नरः ॥
verses.rom: makhaha gramahanta cha yati vaitaranim narah ||

verses.sa:
रेतः पातादिकर्तारो मर्यादाभेदिनो हि ये ।
ते कृष्णे यान्त्यशौचाश्च कुहकाजीविनश्च ये ॥
verses.rom:
retah patadikartaro maryadabhedino hi ye |
te krishne yantyashauchashcha kuhakajivinashcha ye ||

verses.sa:
असिपत्रवनं याति वनच्छेदी वृथैव यः ।
औरभ्रिको मृगव्याधो वह्निज्वाले पतन्ति वै ॥
verses.rom:
asipatravanam yati vanachchhedi vrithaiva yah |
aurabhriko mrigavyadho vahnijvale patanti vai ||

verses.sa: यान्त्येते द्विज तत्रैव ये चापाकेषु वह्निदाः ॥
verses.rom: yantyete dvija tatraiva ye chapakeshu vahnidah ||

verses.sa:
व्रतानां लोपको यश्चस्वाश्रमाद्विच्युतश्च यः ।
सन्दंशयातनामध्ये पततस्तावुभावपि ॥
verses.rom:
vratanam lopako yashchasvashramadvichyutashcha yah |
sandamshayatanamadhye patatastavubhavapi ||

verses.sa:
दिवा स्वप्ने च स्कन्दन्ते ये नरा ब्रह्मचारिणः ।
पुत्रैरध्यापिता ये च ते पतन्ति श्वभोजने ॥
verses.rom:
diva svapne cha skandante ye nara brahmacharinah |
putrairadhyapita ye cha te patanti shvabhojane ||

verses.sa:
एते चान्ये च नरकाः शतशोथ सहस्रशः ।
येषु दुष्कृतकर्माणः पच्यन्ते यातनागताः ॥
verses.rom:
ete chanye cha narakah shatashotha sahasrashah |
yeshu dushkritakarmanah pachyante yatanagatah ||

verses.sa:
यथैव पापान्येतानि तथान्यानि सहस्रशः ।
भुज्यन्ते तानि पुरुषैर्नरकान्तरगोचरैः ॥
verses.rom:
yathaiva papanyetani tathanyani sahasrashah |
bhujyante tani purushairnarakantaragocharaih ||

verses.sa:
वर्णाश्रमविरुद्धं च कर्म कुर्वन्ति ये नराः ।
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा निरयेषु पतन्ति ते ॥
verses.rom:
varnashramaviruddham cha karma kurvanti ye narah |
karmana manasa vacha nirayeshu patanti te ||

verses.sa:
अधः शिरोभिदृश्यन्ते नारकैर्दिवि देवताः ।
देवाश्चाधोमुखान्सर्वानधः पश्यन्ति नारकान् ॥
verses.rom:
adhah shirobhidrishyante narakairdivi devatah |
devashchadhomukhansarvanadhah pashyanti narakan ||

verses.sa:
स्थावराः क्रिमयोब्जाश्च पक्षिणः पशवो नराः ।
धार्मिकास्त्रिदशास्तद्धन्मोक्षिणश्च यथाक्रमम् ॥
verses.rom:
sthavarah krimayobjashcha pakshinah pashavo narah |
dharmikastridashastaddhanmokshinashcha yathakramam ||

verses.sa:
सहस्रभागप्रथमा द्वितीयानुक्रमास्तथा ।
सर्वे ह्येते महाभागा यावन्मुक्तिसमाश्रयाः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasrabhagaprathama dvitiyanukramastatha |
sarve hyete mahabhaga yavanmuktisamashrayah ||

verses.sa:
यावन्तो जन्तवः स्वर्गे तावन्तो नरकौकसः ।
पापकृद्याति नरकं प्रायाश्चित्तपराङ्मुखः ॥
verses.rom:
yavanto jantavah svarge tavanto narakaukasah |
papakridyati narakam prayashchittaparanmukhah ||

verses.sa:
पापानामनुरूपाणि प्रायश्चित्तानि यद्यथा ।
तथा तथैव संस्मृत्य प्रोक्तानि परमर्षिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
papanamanurupani prayashchittani yadyatha |
tatha tathaiva samsmritya proktani paramarshibhih ||

verses.sa:
पापे गुरूणि गुरुणि स्वल्पान्यल्पे च तद्विदः ।
प्रायश्चित्तानि मैत्रेय जगुः स्वायंभुवादयः ॥
verses.rom:
pape guruni guruni svalpanyalpe cha tadvidah |
prayashchittani maitreya jaguh svayambhuvadayah ||

verses.sa:
प्रायश्चित्तान्यशेषाणि तपःकर्मात्मकानि वै ।
यानि तेषामशेषाणां कृष्णानुस्मरणम्परम् ॥
verses.rom:
prayashchittanyasheshani tapahkarmatmakani vai |
yani teshamasheshanam krishnanusmaranamparam ||

verses.sa:
कृते पापेऽनुतापो वै यस्य पुंसः प्रजायते ।
प्रायश्चित्तं तु तस्यैकं हरिसंस्मरणं परम् ॥
verses.rom:
krite pape'nutapo vai yasya pumsah prajayate |
prayashchittam tu tasyaikam harisamsmaranam param ||

verses.sa:
प्रातर्निशि तथा सन्ध्यामध्याह्नादिषु संस्मरन् ।
नारायणमवाप्नोति सद्यः पापक्षयन्नरः ।
विष्णुसंस्मरणात्क्षीणसमस्तक्लेशसञ्चयः ।
मुक्तिं प्रयाति स्वर्गाप्तिस्तस्य विघ्नोनुमीयते ॥
verses.rom:
pratarnishi tatha sandhyamadhyahnadishu samsmaran |
narayanamavapnoti sadyah papakshayannarah |
vishnusamsmaranatkshinasamastakleshasanchayah |
muktim prayati svargaptistasya vighnonumiyate ||

verses.sa:
वासुदेवे मनो यस्यजपहोमार्चनादिषु ।
तस्यान्तरायो मैत्रेय देवेन्द्रत्वादिकं फलम् ॥
verses.rom:
vasudeve mano yasyajapahomarchanadishu |
tasyantarayo maitreya devendratvadikam phalam ||

verses.sa:
क्व नाकपृष्ठगमनं पुनरावृत्तिलक्षणम् ।
क्व जपो वासुदेवेति मुक्तिबीजमनुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
kva nakaprishthagamanam punaravrittilakshanam |
kva japo vasudeveti muktibijamanuttamam ||

verses.sa:
तस्मादहर्निशं विष्णुं संस्मरन्पुरुषो मुने ।
न याति नरकं मर्त्यः संक्षीणाखिलपातकः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadaharnisham vishnum samsmaranpurusho mune |
na yati narakam martyah samkshinakhilapatakah ||

verses.sa:
मनः प्रीतिकरः स्वर्गो नरकस्तद्विपर्ययः ।
नरकस्वर्गसंज्ञे वै पापपुण्ये द्विजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
manah pritikarah svargo narakastadviparyayah |
narakasvargasamjne vai papapunye dvijottama ||

verses.sa:
वस्त्वेकमेव दुःखाय सुखायेर्ष्यागमाय च ।
कोपाय च यतस्तस्माद्वस्तु वस्त्वात्मकं कुतः ॥
verses.rom:
vastvekameva duhkhaya sukhayershyagamaya cha |
kopaya cha yatastasmadvastu vastvatmakam kutah ||

verses.sa:
तदेव प्रीतये भूत्वा पुनर्दुःखाय जायते ।
तदेव कोपाय यतः प्रसादाय च जायते ॥
verses.rom:
tadeva pritaye bhutva punarduhkhaya jayate |
tadeva kopaya yatah prasadaya cha jayate ||

verses.sa:
तस्माद्दुःखात्मकं नास्ति न च किञ्चित्सुखात्मकम् ।
मनसः परिणामोयं सुखदुःखादिलक्षणः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadduhkhatmakam nasti na cha kinchitsukhatmakam |
manasah parinamoyam sukhaduhkhadilakshanah ||

verses.sa:
ज्ञानमेव परं ब्रह्म ज्ञानं बन्धाय चेष्यते ।
ज्ञानात्मकमिदं विश्वं न ज्ञानाद्विद्यते परम् ॥
verses.rom:
jnanameva param brahma jnanam bandhaya cheshyate |
jnanatmakamidam vishvam na jnanadvidyate param ||

verses.sa: विद्याविद्येति मैत्रेय ज्ञानमेवोपधारय ॥
verses.rom: vidyavidyeti maitreya jnanamevopadharaya ||

verses.sa:
एवमेतन्मयाख्यातं भवतो मण्डलं भुवः ।
पातालानि च सर्वाणि तथैव नरका द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
evametanmayakhyatam bhavato mandalam bhuvah |
patalani cha sarvani tathaiva naraka dvija ||

verses.sa:
समुद्राः पर्वताश्चैव द्वीपा वर्षाणि निम्नगाः ।
संक्षेपात्सर्वमाख्यातं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥
verses.rom:
samudrah parvatashchaiva dvipa varshani nimnagah |
samkshepatsarvamakhyatam kim bhuyah shrotumichchhasi ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे द्वितीयेऽंशे षष्ठोऽध्यायः (६)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane dvitiye'mshe shashtho'dhyayah (6)

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—O Brahman, there are some hells below the earth and the waters into which sinners fall. I shall give you an account, O great Muni.

The names of the various hells are: Raurava, Sukara, Rodha, Tala, Visāsana, Mahajwala, Taptakumbha, Lavana, Vimohana, Rudhirāndha, Vaitarani, Krimishā, Krimibhojana, Asipatravana, Krishna, Lalābhaksha, Daruna, Puyavāha, Pāpa, Vahnijwala, Adhosiras, Sandansa, Kālasutra, Tamas, Avichi, Swabhojana, Apratishtha, and another Avichi. These are the dreadful hells constituting the various provinces of the kingdom of Yama dreadful with his instruments of torture, into which are hurled down those persons, who are addicted to sinful actions.

Those who give false evidence, those who act as mediators through partiality, those who speak untruth, are thrown into the Raurava (dreadful) hell. He, who causes abortion, devastates a town, kills a cow, or strangles a man to death goes to the Rodha hell (or that of obstruction). He who drinks intoxicating liquors, destroys a Brāhmana, steals gold or associates with them who perpetrate these crimes, goes to the Sukara (swine) hell. He, who murders a Kshatriya or a Vaiçya or commits adultery with the wife of his preceptor, is despatched to the Tālā (padlock) hell. And one, who holds incestuous intercourse with his sister or slays royal emissary, goes to Taptakumbha (heated jar) hell. One, who sells his chaste wife, the jailor, one who deals in horses and forsakes his followers, is sent to Taptalohā (red-hot iron) hell. One who commits incest with a daughter-in-law and daughter is sent into Mahajawla hell. That vile of a man who disrespects his spiritual guide or his betters, who reviles the Vedas or sells them and who associates with women to whom they should not go, is sent into Lavana hell. A thief and a hater of prescribed rites fall into Vimohana hell. He who disrespects his father, the Brahmanas and the gods, or one who spoils gems, falls into the Krimibhoksha hell. He, who practises magic rites to injure others, falls into Krimisa hell. That vile of a man who takes his meals before offering food to the gods, to the manes and guests is despatched into Lalabhoksha hell (where saliva is given for food.) One who makes arrows is sent into Vidhaka hell. He, who makes lances, swords and other weapons, is sent into the dreadful hell of Visashana (murderous.) He who takes bribes is sent into Adhomukha hell (in which head is inverted) as well as he who offers sacrifices to improper objects and predicts the movements of stars and planets. One who eats alone sweetmeats, a Brāhmana who deals in lac, flesh, liquors, sesamum, or salt, one who commits violence, and those who rear up cats, cocks, goats, dogs, hogs and birds are despatched into hell Puyavaha (or where matter flows.) The Brāhman who leads the life of an actor, fisherman, who depends upon a person born in adultery, who is a prisoner, an informer, one who lives by his wife's immoral habits, who looks to secular affairs on Parva days, who is an incendiary, a faithless friend, a soothsayer, who vends birds, performs religious rites for the rustics, who sells the juice of some trees is thrown into Rudhirandha hell (whose wells are blood). He, who spoils honey or devastates a village, is sent into Vaitarani hell. He, who causes impotence, trespasses upon others' lands, is impure and lives on magic rites, is sent into the Krishna hell (black). He who uselessly cuts down trees goes to Asipatravana hell; Those who tend on sheep, those who hunt deer and those who give fire to unbaked vessels are sent to Vahnijwāla hell or of fiery flame. One, who violates his own vow or transgresses the rules of his own order, goes into the Sandansana (or the hell of pincers.) The religious student who sleeps in the day and becomes defiled and those who receive instruction from their children go to the hell called Swābhojana (where they feed upon dogs).

Besides these there are hundreds and thousands of other hells, where persons, perpetrating diverse iniquities, are visited with various punishments. There are thousands of hells like the numberless crimes committed by men, in which they are punished according to the nature of their offences. And those who swerve from the obligations laid upon them by their caste or order, in thought, word or deed are thrown into these hells. The celestials are seen by those who are thrown into these hells, with their own heads inverted and the celestials also behold the inhabitants of hell with their heads downwards. After undergoing the sufferings of hell the sinners go through the various stages of existence, namely:—inanimate things, the aquatic animals, birds, animals, men, pious men, gods and liberated spirits. O great sage, each of these stages is in succession a thousand degrees superior to that which precedes it. People go through these stages until they obtain emancipation. There are as many inhabitants in hell as are in heaven: those who commit sin and do not make an expiation of guilt proceed to hell. Becoming acts of expiation for every short of iniquity have been laid down by the great sages. O Maitreya, Swayambhuba and others have dictated severe penances for great crimes, and light ones for ordinary offences. Amongst the numerous arduous penances laid down by them, the remembrance of Hari is the foremost. For them, who are penitent after having committed many iniquities, the greatest penance is the remembrance of Hari. If a man meditates upon Hari either in the morning, at sunset, midday or at night he is released from all sins. By meditating upon Vishnu he is released from the heap of worldly afflictions. He obtains final emancipation considering even heaven as impediment. He, whose mind is devoted to Vāsudeva in prayer, burnt offering or adoration, considers, O Maitreya, even the dignity of Indra as an obstacle to the acquirement of final liberation. What is the use of going to heaven whence it is necessary to come back to earth? And how different is the meditation of Vāsudeva which leads to final liberation. Therefore, O Muni, the man, who meditates upon Vāsudeva day and night, is released from all sins and does not go to Naraka after death. O foremost of twice-born ones, that which gives delight to mind is heaven, and that which gives pain is hell, hence vice is denominated as hell and virtue as heaven. The self-same thing some times gives delight, sometimes produces pains, sometimes excites jealousy and sometimes anger. Therefore every thing (in this world) is the source of miseries. The same thing at one time brings on anger and again conduces to our delight. Therefore nothing in itself is either pleasurable or painful; pleasure, pain and the like merely denominate the various states of the mind. Therefore true wisdom consists only in the knowledge of Brahmā, which brings on confinement to the world. True wisdom pervades through the whole universe and there is the existence of no other thing but this; ignorance and knowledge are therefore comprised in true wisdom, O Maitreya. O twice-born one, I have thus described to you the entire earth, all the divisions of the region under the earth and the hells, the oceans, the mountains, the insular continents, and the rivers. I have described all to you in short, what again do you hear?

verses.sa:
कथितं भूतलं ब्रह्मन्ममैतदखिलं त्वया ।
भुवर्लोकादिकाँ ल्लोकाञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं मुने ॥
verses.rom:
kathitam bhutalam brahmanmamaitadakhilam tvaya |
bhuvarlokadikan llokanchhrotumichchhamyaham mune ||

verses.sa:
तथैव ग्रहसंस्थानं प्रमाणानि यथा तथा ।
समाचक्ष्व महाभाग तन्मह्यं परिपृच्छते ॥
verses.rom:
tathaiva grahasamsthanam pramanani yatha tatha |
samachakshva mahabhaga tanmahyam pariprichchhate ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच ।
रविचन्द्र मसोर्यावन्मयूखैरवभास्यते ।
ससमुद्र सरिच्छैला तावती पृथिवी स्मृता ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha |
ravichandra masoryavanmayukhairavabhasyate |
sasamudra sarichchhaila tavati prithivi smrita ||

verses.sa:
यावत्प्रमाणा पृथिवी विस्तारपरिमण्डलात् ।
नभस्तावन्प्रमाणं वै व्यासमण्डलतो द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
yavatpramana prithivi vistaraparimandalat |
nabhastavanpramanam vai vyasamandalato dvija ||

verses.sa:
भूमेर्यो जनलक्षे तु सौरं मैत्रेय मण्डलम् ।
लक्षाद्दिवाकरस्यापि मण्डलं शशिनः स्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhumeryo janalakshe tu sauram maitreya mandalam |
lakshaddivakarasyapi mandalam shashinah sthitam ||

verses.sa:
पूर्णे शतसहस्रे तु योजनानां निशाकरात् ।
नक्षत्रमण्डलं कृत्स्नमुपरिष्टात्प्रकाशते ॥
verses.rom:
purne shatasahasre tu yojananam nishakarat |
nakshatramandalam kritsnamuparishtatprakashate ||

verses.sa:
द्वे लक्षे चोत्तरे ब्रह्मन् बुधो नक्षत्रमण्डलात् ।
तावत्प्रमाणभागे तु बुधस्याप्युशनाः स्थितः ॥
verses.rom:
dve lakshe chottare brahman budho nakshatramandalat |
tavatpramanabhage tu budhasyapyushanah sthitah ||

verses.sa:
अङ्गारकोपि शुक्रस्य तत्प्रमाणे व्यवस्थितः ।
लक्षद्वये तु भौमस्य स्थितो देवपुरोहितः ॥
verses.rom:
angarakopi shukrasya tatpramane vyavasthitah |
lakshadvaye tu bhaumasya sthito devapurohitah ||

verses.sa:
सौरिर्बृहस्पतेश्चोर्ध्वं द्विलक्षे समवस्थितः ।
सप्तर्षिमण्डलं तस्माल्लक्षमेकं द्विजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
saurirbrihaspateshchordhvam dvilakshe samavasthitah |
saptarshimandalam tasmallakshamekam dvijottama ||

verses.sa:
ऋषिभ्यस्तु सहस्राणां शतादूर्ध्वं व्यवस्थितः ।
मेढीभूतः समस्तस्य ज्योतिश्चक्रस्य वै ध्रुवः ॥
verses.rom:
rishibhyastu sahasranam shatadurdhvam vyavasthitah |
medhibhutah samastasya jyotishchakrasya vai dhruvah ||

verses.sa:
त्रैलोक्यमेतत्कथितमुत्सेधेन महामुने ।
इज्याफलस्य भूरेषा इज्या चात्र प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
verses.rom:
trailokyametatkathitamutsedhena mahamune |
ijyaphalasya bhuresha ijya chatra pratishthita ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुवादूर्ध्वं महर्लोको यत्र ते कल्पवासिनः ।
एकयोजनकोटिस्तु यत्र ते कल्पवासिनः ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvadurdhvam maharloko yatra te kalpavasinah |
ekayojanakotistu yatra te kalpavasinah ||

verses.sa:
द्वे कोटी तु जनो लोको यत्र ते ब्रह्मणः सुताः ।
सनन्दनाद्याः प्रथिता मैत्रेयामलचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
dve koti tu jano loko yatra te brahmanah sutah |
sanandanadyah prathita maitreyamalachetasah ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्गणोत्तरे चोर्ध्वं जनलोकात्तपः स्थितः ।
वैराजा यत्र ते देवाः स्थिता दाहविर्जिताः ॥
verses.rom:
chaturganottare chordhvam janalokattapah sthitah |
vairaja yatra te devah sthita dahavirjitah ||

verses.sa:
षड्गुणेन तपोलोकात्सत्यलोको विराजते ।
अपुनर्मारका यत्र ब्रह्मलोको हि संस्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
shadgunena tapolokatsatyaloko virajate |
apunarmaraka yatra brahmaloko hi samsmritah ||

verses.sa:
पादगम्यन्तु यत्किञ्चिद्वस्त्वस्ति पृथिवीमयम् ।
स भूर्लोकः समाख्यातो विस्तरोस्य मयोदितः ॥
verses.rom:
padagamyantu yatkinchidvastvasti prithivimayam |
sa bhurlokah samakhyato vistarosya mayoditah ||

verses.sa:
भूमिसूर्यान्तरं यच्च सिद्धादिमुनिसेवितम् ।
भुवर्लोकस्तु सोप्युक्तो द्वितीयो मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
bhumisuryantaram yachcha siddhadimunisevitam |
bhuvarlokastu sopyukto dvitiyo munisattama ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुवसूर्यान्तरं यच्च नियुतानि चतुर्दश ।
स्वर्लोकः सोपि गदितो लोकसंस्थानचिन्तकैः ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvasuryantaram yachcha niyutani chaturdasha |
svarlokah sopi gadito lokasamsthanachintakaih ||

verses.sa:
त्रैलोक्यमेतत्कृतकं मैत्रेय परिपठ्यते ।
जनस्तपस्तथा सत्यमिति चाकृतकं त्रयम् ॥
verses.rom:
trailokyametatkritakam maitreya paripathyate |
janastapastatha satyamiti chakritakam trayam ||

verses.sa:
कृतकाकृतयोर्मध्ये महर्लोक इति स्मृतः ।
शून्यो भवति कल्पान्ते योत्यन्तं न विनश्यति ॥
verses.rom:
kritakakritayormadhye maharloka iti smritah |
shunyo bhavati kalpante yotyantam na vinashyati ||

verses.sa:
एते सप्त मया लोका मैत्रेय कथितास्तव ।
पातालानि च सप्तैव ब्रह्माण्डस्यैष विस्तरः ॥
verses.rom:
ete sapta maya loka maitreya kathitastava |
patalani cha saptaiva brahmandasyaisha vistarah ||

verses.sa:
एतदण्डकटाहेन तिर्यक् चोर्ध्वमधस्तथा ।
कपित्थस्य यथा बीजं सर्वतो वै समावृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
etadandakatahena tiryak chordhvamadhastatha |
kapitthasya yatha bijam sarvato vai samavritam ||

verses.sa:
दशोत्तरेण पयसा मैत्रेयांडं च तद्वृतम् ।
सर्वोम्बुपरिधानोसौ वह्निना वेष्टितो बहिः ॥
verses.rom:
dashottarena payasa maitreyamdam cha tadvritam |
sarvombuparidhanosau vahnina veshtito bahih ||

verses.sa:
वह्निश्च वायुना वायुर्मैत्रेय नभसा वृतः ।
भूतादिना नभः सोपि महता परहिवेष्टितः ।
देशोत्तराण्यश्षोआ!णि मैत्रेयैतानि सप्त वै ॥
verses.rom:
vahnishcha vayuna vayurmaitreya nabhasa vritah |
bhutadina nabhah sopi mahata parahiveshtitah |
deshottaranyashshoa!ni maitreyaitani sapta vai ||

verses.sa:
महान्तं च समावृत्य प्रधानं समवस्थितम् ।
अनन्तस्य न तस्यान्तः संख्यानं चापि विद्यते ॥
verses.rom:
mahantam cha samavritya pradhanam samavasthitam |
anantasya na tasyantah samkhyanam chapi vidyate ||

verses.sa:
तदन्तमसंख्यातप्रमाणं चापि वै यतः ।
हेतुभूतमसेषस्य प्रकृतिः सा परा मुने ॥
verses.rom:
tadantamasamkhyatapramanam chapi vai yatah |
hetubhutamaseshasya prakritih sa para mune ||

verses.sa:
अंडानां तु सहस्राणां सहस्राण्ययुतानि च ।
ईदृशानां तथा तत्र कोटिकोटिशतानि च ॥
verses.rom:
amdanam tu sahasranam sahasranyayutani cha |
idrishanam tatha tatra kotikotishatani cha ||

verses.sa:
हारुण्यग्निर्यथा तैलं तिले तद्वत्पुमानपि ।
प्रधानेऽवस्थितो व्यापी चेतनात्मात्मवेदनः ॥
verses.rom:
harunyagniryatha tailam tile tadvatpumanapi |
pradhane'vasthito vyapi chetanatmatmavedanah ||

verses.sa:
प्रधानं च पुमांश्चैव सर्वभूतात्मभूतया ।
विष्णुशक्त्या महाबुद्धे वृतौ संश्रयधर्मिणौ ॥
verses.rom:
pradhanam cha pumamshchaiva sarvabhutatmabhutaya |
vishnushaktya mahabuddhe vritau samshrayadharminau ||

verses.sa:
तयोः सैव पृथग्भावकारणं संश्रयस्य च ।
क्षोभकारणभूता च सर्गकाले महामते ॥
verses.rom:
tayoh saiva prithagbhavakaranam samshrayasya cha |
kshobhakaranabhuta cha sargakale mahamate ||

verses.sa:
यथा सक्तं जले वातो बिभर्त्ति कणिकाशतम् ।
शक्तिः सापि तथा विष्णोः प्रधानपुरुषात्मकम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha saktam jale vato bibhartti kanikashatam |
shaktih sapi tatha vishnoh pradhanapurushatmakam ||

verses.sa:
यथा च पादयोर्मूलस्कन्धशाखादिसंयुतः ।
आदिबीजात्प्रभवति बीजान्यन्यानि वै ततः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha cha padayormulaskandhashakhadisamyutah |
adibijatprabhavati bijanyanyani vai tatah ||

verses.sa:
प्रभवन्ति ततस्तेभ्यः सम्भवन्त्यपरे द्रु माः ।
तेपि तल्लक्षणद्र व्यकारणानुगता मुने ॥
verses.rom:
prabhavanti tatastebhyah sambhavantyapare dru mah |
tepi tallakshanadra vyakarananugata mune ||

verses.sa:
एवमव्याकृतात्पूर्वं जायन्ते महदादयः ।
विशेषान्तास्ततस्तेभ्यः संभवंत्यसुरादयः ।
तेभ्यश्च पुत्रास्तेषां च पुत्राणामपरे सुताः ॥
verses.rom:
evamavyakritatpurvam jayante mahadadayah |
visheshantastatastebhyah sambhavamtyasuradayah |
tebhyashcha putrastesham cha putranamapare sutah ||

verses.sa:
बीजाद्वृक्षप्ररोहेण यथा नापचयस्तरोः ।
भूतानां भूतसर्गेण नैवास्त्यपचयस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
bijadvrikshaprarohena yatha napachayastaroh |
bhutanam bhutasargena naivastyapachayastatha ||

verses.sa:
सन्निधानाद्यथाकाशकालाद्याः कारणं तरोः ।
तथैवापरिणामेव विश्वस्य भगवान्हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
sannidhanadyathakashakaladyah karanam taroh |
tathaivaparinameva vishvasya bhagavanharih ||

verses.sa:
व्रीहिबीजे यथा मूलं नालं पत्राङ्कुरौ तथा ।
काण्डकोषस्तु पुष्पं च क्षीरं तद्वच्च तण्डुलाः ॥
verses.rom:
vrihibije yatha mulam nalam patrankurau tatha |
kandakoshastu pushpam cha kshiram tadvachcha tandulah ||

verses.sa:
तुषाः कणाश्च सन्तो वै यान्त्याविर्भावमात्मनः ।
प्ररोहहेतुसामग्र्यमासाद्य मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
tushah kanashcha santo vai yantyavirbhavamatmanah |
prarohahetusamagryamasadya munisattama ||

verses.sa:
तथा कर्मस्वनेकेषु देवाद्याः समवस्थिताः ।
विष्णुशक्तिं समासाद्य प्ररोहमुपयान्ति वै ॥
verses.rom:
tatha karmasvanekeshu devadyah samavasthitah |
vishnushaktim samasadya prarohamupayanti vai ||

verses.sa:
स च विष्णुः परं ब्रह्म यतः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
जगच्च यो यत्र चेदं यस्मिंश्च लयमेष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
sa cha vishnuh param brahma yatah sarvamidam jagat |
jagachcha yo yatra chedam yasmimshcha layameshyati ||

verses.sa:
तद्ब्रह्म तत्परं धाम सदसत्परमं पदम् ।
यस्य सर्वमभेदेन यतश्चैतच्चराचरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadbrahma tatparam dhama sadasatparamam padam |
yasya sarvamabhedena yatashchaitachcharacharam ||

verses.sa:
स एव मूलप्रकृतिर्व्यक्तरूपी जगच्च सः ।
तस्मिन्नेव लयं सर्वं याति तत्र च तिष्ठति ॥
verses.rom:
sa eva mulaprakritirvyaktarupi jagachcha sah |
tasminneva layam sarvam yati tatra cha tishthati ||

verses.sa:
कर्त्ता क्रियाणां स च इज्यते क्रतुः स एवतत्कर्मफलं च तस्य ।
स्रुगादियत्साधनमप्यश्षॐ हरेर्न किञ्चिद्व्यतिरिक्तमस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
kartta kriyanam sa cha ijyate kratuh sa evatatkarmaphalam cha tasya |
srugadiyatsadhanamapyashshaom harerna kinchidvyatiriktamasti ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीवुष्णुमहापुराणे द्वितीयेंशे सप्तमोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivushnumahapurane dvitiyemshe saptamo'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Maitreya said:—The entire earth has been described to me by you. O Brahman, I wish to hear now, O Muni, an account of the regions above the world, the Bhuvar-loka, the situation and dimension of the heavenly bodies. Do you relate them to me, O great sage. Parāçara said—The terrestrial sphere (or Bhurloka) comprising the oceans, rivers and mountains extends as far as it is illuminated by the rays of the sun and the moon. The atmospheric sphere (or the Bhuvar-loka), of the same extent both in diameter and circumference, spreads upwards, O twice-born one, as far as the heaven. The solar region is situated a hundred thousand yojanas from the earth; and the region of the moon is situated at an equal distance from the sun. About the same distance above the moon is situated the orbit of all the lunar constellations. And two hundred thousand yojanas, upwards, O Brahman, is situated the region of the planet Budha (Mercury). And at the same distance above that is situate the planet Sukra (Venus). And at the same distance above that is Angaraka (Mars). And at the same distance above that is the priest of gods (Vrihaspati or Jupiter). And Sani (Saturn) is two hundred and fifty thousand yojanas above Jupiter. O foremost of twice-born ones, one hundred thousand leagues above that is the region of seven Rishis. And at a similar distance above that is Dhruva (the pole-star) the axis of the circle of planets. Thus I have described to you, O great Muni, the elevation of three spheres, which constitute the region of the fruits of works. And the land of works is also here namely Bhārata. At a distance of one Koti yojanas above Dhruva is Maharloha (the region of saints) the inhabitants of which live for a Kalpa (or a day of Brahmā). And at a distance of two Koti yojanas above that is Janaloka where reside the pure-minded sons of Brahmā, Sananda and others, of whom I had described to you before, O Maitryeya. And at a distance of eight Koti yojanas is Tapa-loka where reside the celestials named Baibhrajas, unconsumable by fire. At six times the distance from Tapa-loka is situated Satya-loka, wherein the inhabitants do not know death and which is otherwise named Brahmā-loka. Wherever earthly object exists which may be trodden by feet, that makes up Bhur-loka whose dimensions I have already described to you. The region that extends from the earth to the sun is called Bhur-loka, inhabited by the Siddhas, Munis and others and which is called the second sphere, O foremost of sages. The distance, between the Sun and Dhruva which extends over fourteen hundred thousands leagues, is called Swar-loka by those who are conversant with the position of planets. These three spheres are called transitory, O Maitreya and three, Jana, Tapa and Satya, are termed durable. And Mahar-loka, which is situated between these two, partakes of the nature of the both and though it becomes devoid of all beings at the end of Kalpa it is not finally destroyed. I have thus described to you, O Maitreya, the seven Lokas, and the seven Pātālas constituting the extent of the whole world.

As the seed is covered by its rind so the world is girt on every side and above and below by the shell of the egg of Brahmā. And this shell again, O Maitreya, is encircled by water which extends over space equal to ten times the earth. And the waters again are encompassed on the outer surface by fire. And this fire is encompassed by the air, and the air by the sky, the sky by the origin of the elements and that again by the intellect, O Maitreya. And each of these even extends ten times the breadth of one it encircles, O Maitreya. And the last is encircled by the Chief-Principle. This supreme nature has no end and cannot be measured. It is therefore called endless, immeasurable and the cause of all existing things. This Prakriti, O Muni, is the source of the endless universe and of thousand, ten thousands and millions and thousands of millions of mundane eggs. As fire exists in wood, oil exists in sessamum, so the self-conscious, all-spreading and self-irraviating soul exists in this Pradhāna. O thou of great intellect, this nature and soul exist as dependants and are encompassed by the energy of Vishnu, which is the soul of the universe. O thou of great mind, this energy of Vishnu separates them at the time of dissolution and unites them at the time of creation. And this at the beginning of creation is the cause of this agitation. As the wind agitates the surface of water in a hundred bubbles so this energy of Vishnu which is at one with the nature and soul influences the universe. As a tree, containing root, stem and branches, originates from an original seed and produces other seeds, from which grow other trees, similar in kind to the first, so from Pradhanā germinate intellect and other rudiments of things—from them grow grosser elements—from them Asuras and others and who again are followed by sons and sons of sons. As the first tree is not spoiled when another grows out of it so there is no waste of beings by the creation of others. As space, time and the like are the cause of the tree so the divine Hari is the cause of the developments of the universe. As all the portions of the plant remaining in the seed of rice, or the root, the culm, the leaf, the short, the stem, the bud, the fruit, the milk, the grain, the chaff, the ear, grow up when they come in contact with those things which help their growth (earth and water), so the celestials, men and other beings, remaining in the states to which they are destined in consequence of their good or bad actions, appear in their full growth by virtue of the energy of Vishnu. He is Vishnu, the great Brahmā, from whom the creation of the universe has proceeded, who is the world, in whom the world exists and in whom it will be dissolved. He is Brahmā, the excellent abode, the excellent state, the essence of all that is visible and invisible, from whom proceeds, the creation, animate and inanimate. He is the primary nature, manifestation of the universe, in whom all beings exist and in whom all beings will finally immerge. He is the performer of all devotional rites, he is the sacrifice; he is the fruit that it confers and he is the tools by which it is celebrated. There is no other thing but Hari.

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
व्याख्यातमेतद्ब्रह्माण्डसंस्थानं तव सुव्रत
ततः प्रमाणसंस्थाने सूर्यादीनां शृणुष्व मे ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
vyakhyatametadbrahmandasamsthanam tava suvrata
tatah pramanasamsthane suryadinam shrinushva me ||

verses.sa:
योजनानां सहस्राणि भास्करस्य रथो नव
ईषादण्डस्तथैवास्य द्विगुणो मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
yojananam sahasrani bhaskarasya ratho nava
ishadandastathaivasya dviguno munisattama ||

verses.sa:
सार्धकोटिस्तथा सप्त नियुतान्यधिकानि वै
योजनानां तु तस्याक्षस्तत्र चक्रं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.rom:
sardhakotistatha sapta niyutanyadhikani vai
yojananam tu tasyakshastatra chakram pratishthitam ||

verses.sa:
त्रिनाभिमति पञ्चारे षण्णेमिन्यक्षयात्मके
संवत्सरमये कृत्स्नं कालचक्रं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
verses.rom:
trinabhimati panchare shanneminyakshayatmake
samvatsaramaye kritsnam kalachakram pratishthitam ||

verses.sa:
हयाश्च सप्तच्छन्दांसि तेषां नामानि मे शृणु
गायत्री च बृहत्युष्णिग्जगती त्रिष्टुभेव च
अनुष्टुप्पंक्तिरित्युक्ता छंदांसि हरयो रवेः ॥
verses.rom:
hayashcha saptachchhandamsi tesham namani me shrinu
gayatri cha brihatyushnigjagati trishtubheva cha
anushtuppamktirityukta chhamdamsi harayo raveh ||

verses.sa:
चत्वारिंशत्सहस्रणिद्वितीयोऽक्षो विवस्वतः
पञ्चान्यानि तु सार्धानि स्यन्दनस्य महामते ॥
verses.rom:
chatvarimshatsahasranidvitiyo'ksho vivasvatah
panchanyani tu sardhani syandanasya mahamate ||

verses.sa:
अक्षप्रमाणमुभयोः प्रमाणं तद्युगार्द्धयो
ह्रस्वोक्षस्तद्युगार्द्धेन ध्रुवाधारो रथस्य वै
द्वितीयेक्षे तु तच्चक्रं संस्थितं मानसाचले ॥
verses.rom:
akshapramanamubhayoh pramanam tadyugarddhayo
hrasvokshastadyugarddhena dhruvadharo rathasya vai
dvitiyekshe tu tachchakram samsthitam manasachale ||

verses.sa:
मानसोत्तरशैलस्य पूर्वतो वासवी पुरी
दक्षिणे तु यमस्यान्याप्रतीच्यां वरुणस्य च
उत्तरेण च सोमस्य तासां नामानि मे शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
manasottarashailasya purvato vasavi puri
dakshine tu yamasyanyapratichyam varunasya cha
uttarena cha somasya tasam namani me shrinu ||

verses.sa:
वस्वौकसारा शक्रस्य याम्या संयमनी तथा
पुरी सुखाजलेशस्य सोमस्य च विभावरी ॥
verses.rom:
vasvaukasara shakrasya yamya samyamani tatha
puri sukhajaleshasya somasya cha vibhavari ||

verses.sa:
काष्ठां गतो दक्षिणतः क्षिप्तेषुरिव सर्पति
मैत्रेय भगवान्भानुर्ज्योतिषां चक्रसंयुतः ॥
verses.rom:
kashtham gato dakshinatah kshipteshuriva sarpati
maitreya bhagavanbhanurjyotisham chakrasamyutah ||

verses.sa:
अहोरात्रव्यवस्थानकारणं भगवान्रविः
देवयानः परः पन्था योगिनां क्लेशसंक्षये ॥
verses.rom:
ahoratravyavasthanakaranam bhagavanravih
devayanah parah pantha yoginam kleshasamkshaye ||

verses.sa:
दिवसस्य रविर्मध्ये सर्वकालं व्यवस्थितः
सर्वद्वीपेषु मैत्रेय निशार्द्धस्य च सन्मुखः ॥
verses.rom:
divasasya ravirmadhye sarvakalam vyavasthitah
sarvadvipeshu maitreya nisharddhasya cha sanmukhah ||

verses.sa:
उदयास्तमने चैव सर्वकालं तु सम्मुखे
विदिशासु त्वश्षोआ!सु तथा ब्रह्मन् दिशासु च ॥
verses.rom:
udayastamane chaiva sarvakalam tu sammukhe
vidishasu tvashshoa!su tatha brahman dishasu cha ||

verses.sa:
यैर्यत्र दृश्यते भास्वान्स तेषामुदयः स्मृतः
तिरोभावं च यत्रैति तत्रैवास्तमनं रवेः ॥
verses.rom:
yairyatra drishyate bhasvansa teshamudayah smritah
tirobhavam cha yatraiti tatraivastamanam raveh ||

verses.sa:
नैवास्तमनमर्कस्य नोदयः सर्वदा सतः
उदयास्तमनाख्यं हि दर्शनादर्शनं रवेः ॥
verses.rom:
naivastamanamarkasya nodayah sarvada satah
udayastamanakhyam hi darshanadarshanam raveh ||

verses.sa:
शक्रादीनां पुरे तिष्ठन् स्पृशत्येष पुरत्रयम्
विकोणौ द्वौ विकोणस्थस्त्रीन् कोणान्द्वे पुरे तथा ॥
verses.rom:
shakradinam pure tishthan sprishatyesha puratrayam
vikonau dvau vikonasthastrin konandve pure tatha ||

verses.sa:
उदितो वर्द्धमानाभिरामध्याह्नात्तपन्रविः
ततः परं ह्रसन्तीभिर्गोभिरस्तं नियच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
udito varddhamanabhiramadhyahnattapanravih
tatah param hrasantibhirgobhirastam niyachchhati ||

verses.sa:
उदयास्तमनाभ्यां च स्मृते पूर्वापरे दिशौ
यावत्पुरस्तात्तपति तावत्पृष्ठे च पार्श्वयोः ॥
verses.rom:
udayastamanabhyam cha smrite purvapare dishau
yavatpurastattapati tavatprishthe cha parshvayoh ||

verses.sa:
ऋतेऽमरगिरेर्मेरोरुपरि ब्रह्मणः सभाम्
येये मरीचयोर्कस्य प्रयान्ति ब्रह्मणः सभाम्
तेते निरस्तास्तद्भासा प्रतीपमुपयान्ति वै ॥
verses.rom:
rite'maragirermerorupari brahmanah sabham
yeye marichayorkasya prayanti brahmanah sabham
tete nirastastadbhasa pratipamupayanti vai ||

verses.sa:
तस्माद्दिश्युत्तरस्यां वै दिवारात्रिः सदैव हि
सर्वेषां द्वीपवर्षाणां मेरुरुत्तरतो यतः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmaddishyuttarasyam vai divaratrih sadaiva hi
sarvesham dvipavarshanam meruruttarato yatah ||

verses.sa:
प्रभा विवस्वतो रात्रावस्तं गच्छति भास्करे
विशत्यग्निमतो रात्रौ वह्निर्दूरात्प्रकाशते ॥
verses.rom:
prabha vivasvato ratravastam gachchhati bhaskare
vishatyagnimato ratrau vahnirduratprakashate ||

verses.sa:
वह्नेः प्रभा तथा भानुर्दिनेष्वाविशति द्विज
अतीव वह्निसंयोगादतः सूर्यः प्रकाशते ॥
verses.rom:
vahneh prabha tatha bhanurdineshvavishati dvija
ativa vahnisamyogadatah suryah prakashate ||

verses.sa:
तेजसी भास्कराग्नेये प्रकाशोष्णस्वरूपिणी
परस्परानुप्रवेशादाप्यायेते दिवानिशम् ॥
verses.rom:
tejasi bhaskaragneye prakashoshnasvarupini
parasparanupraveshadapyayete divanisham ||

verses.sa:
दक्षिणोत्तरभूम्यर्द्धे समुत्तिष्ठति भास्करे
अहोरात्रं विशत्यम्भस्तमः प्राकाश्यशीलवत् ॥
verses.rom:
dakshinottarabhumyarddhe samuttishthati bhaskare
ahoratram vishatyambhastamah prakashyashilavat ||

verses.sa:
आताम्रा हि भवत्यापो दिवानक्तप्रवेशनात्
दिनं विशति चैवांभो भास्करेस्तमुपेयुषि
तस्माच्छुक्ला भवन्त्यापो नक्तमह्नः प्रवेशनात् ॥
verses.rom:
atamra hi bhavatyapo divanaktapraveshanat
dinam vishati chaivambho bhaskarestamupeyushi
tasmachchhukla bhavantyapo naktamahnah praveshanat ||

verses.sa:
एवं पुष्करमध्येन यदा याति दिवाकरः
त्रिंशद्भागस्तु मेदिन्यास्तदा मौहूर्त्तिकी गतिः ॥
verses.rom:
evam pushkaramadhyena yada yati divakarah
trimshadbhagastu medinyastada mauhurttiki gatih ||

verses.sa:
कुलालचक्रपर्यन्ते भ्रमन्नेष दिवाकरः
करोत्यहस्तथा रात्रिं विमुञ्चन्मेदिनीं द्विजः ॥
verses.rom:
kulalachakraparyante bhramannesha divakarah
karotyahastatha ratrim vimunchanmedinim dvijah ||

verses.sa:
अयनस्योत्तरस्यादौ मकरं याति भास्करः
ततः कुम्भं च मीनं च राशो! राश्यंतरं द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
ayanasyottarasyadau makaram yati bhaskarah
tatah kumbham cha minam cha rasho! rashyamtaram dvija ||

verses.sa:
त्रिष्वेतेष्वथ भुक्तेषु ततो वैषुवतीं गतिम्
प्रयाति सविता कुर्वन्नहोरात्रं ततः समम् ॥
verses.rom:
trishveteshvatha bhukteshu tato vaishuvatim gatim
prayati savita kurvannahoratram tatah samam ||

verses.sa: ततो रात्रिः क्षयं याति वर्द्धतेऽनुदिनं दिनम् ॥
verses.rom: tato ratrih kshayam yati varddhate'nudinam dinam ||

verses.sa:
ततश्च मिथुनस्यान्ते परां काष्ठामुपागतः
राशिं कर्कटकं प्राप्य कुरुते दक्षिणायनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatashcha mithunasyante param kashthamupagatah
rashim karkatakam prapya kurute dakshinayanam ||

verses.sa:
कुलालचक्रपर्यंतो यथाशीघ्रं प्रवर्त्तते
दक्षिणप्रक्रमे सूर्यस्तथा शीघ्रं प्रवर्त्तते ॥
verses.rom:
kulalachakraparyamto yathashighram pravarttate
dakshinaprakrame suryastatha shighram pravarttate ||

verses.sa:
अतिवेगितया कालं वायुवेगबलाच्चरन्
तस्मात्प्रकृष्टां भूमिं तु कालेनाल्पेन गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
ativegitaya kalam vayuvegabalachcharan
tasmatprakrishtam bhumim tu kalenalpena gachchhati ||

verses.sa:
सूर्यो द्वादशभिः शैघ्र्यानमुहूर्त्ते दक्षिणायने
त्रयोदशार्द्धमृक्षाणामह्ना तु चरति द्विज
मुहूर्त्तैस्तावदृक्षाणि नक्तमष्टादशैश्चरन् ॥
verses.rom:
suryo dvadashabhih shaighryanamuhurtte dakshinayane
trayodasharddhamrikshanamahna tu charati dvija
muhurttaistavadrikshani naktamashtadashaishcharan ||

verses.sa:
कुलालचक्रमध्यस्थो यथा मन्दं प्रसर्पति
तथोदगयने सूर्यः सर्पते मन्दविक्रमः ॥
verses.rom:
kulalachakramadhyastho yatha mandam prasarpati
tathodagayane suryah sarpate mandavikramah ||

verses.sa:
तस्माद्दीर्घेण कालेन भूमिमल्पां तु गच्छति
अष्टादशमुहूर्तं यदुत्तरायणपश्चिमम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasmaddirghena kalena bhumimalpam tu gachchhati
ashtadashamuhurtam yaduttarayanapashchimam ||

verses.sa: अहर्भवति तच्चापि चरते मन्दविक्रमः ॥
verses.rom: aharbhavati tachchapi charate mandavikramah ||

verses.sa:
त्रयोदशार्द्धमह्ना तु ऋक्षाणां चरते रविः
मुहूर्त्तैस्तावदृक्षाणि रात्रौ द्वादशभिश्चरन् ॥
verses.rom:
trayodasharddhamahna tu rikshanam charate ravih
muhurttaistavadrikshani ratrau dvadashabhishcharan ||

verses.sa:
अतो मन्दतरं नाभ्यां चक्रं भ्रमति वै यथा
मृत्पिण्ड इव मध्यस्थो ध्रुवो भ्रमति वै तथा ॥
verses.rom:
ato mandataram nabhyam chakram bhramati vai yatha
mritpinda iva madhyastho dhruvo bhramati vai tatha ||

verses.sa:
कुलालचक्रनाभिस्तु यथा तत्रैव वर्तते
ध्रुवस्तथा हि मैत्रेय तत्रैव परिवर्तते ॥
verses.rom:
kulalachakranabhistu yatha tatraiva vartate
dhruvastatha hi maitreya tatraiva parivartate ||

verses.sa:
उभयोः काष्ठयोर्मध्ये भ्रमतो मण्डलानि तु
दिवा नक्तं च सूर्यस्य मन्दा शीघ्रा च वै गतिः ॥
verses.rom:
ubhayoh kashthayormadhye bhramato mandalani tu
diva naktam cha suryasya manda shighra cha vai gatih ||

verses.sa:
मन्दाह्नि यस्मिन्नयने शीघ्रा नक्तं तदा गतिः
शीघ्रा निशि यदा चास्य तदा मंदा दिवा गतिः ॥
verses.rom:
mandahni yasminnayane shighra naktam tada gatih
shighra nishi yada chasya tada mamda diva gatih ||

verses.sa:
एक प्रमाणमेवैष मार्गं याति दिवाकरः
अहोरात्रेण यो भुंक्ते समस्ता राशयो द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
eka pramanamevaisha margam yati divakarah
ahoratrena yo bhumkte samasta rashayo dvija ||

verses.sa: षडेव राशीन् यो भुंक्ते रात्रावन्यांश्च षड्दिवा ॥
verses.rom: shadeva rashin yo bhumkte ratravanyamshcha shaddiva ||

verses.sa:
राशिप्रमाणजनिता दीर्घह्रस्वात्मता दिने
तथा निशायां राशीनां प्रमाणैर्लघुदीर्घता ॥
verses.rom:
rashipramanajanita dirghahrasvatmata dine
tatha nishayam rashinam pramanairlaghudirghata ||

verses.sa:
दिनादेर्दिर्घह्रस्वत्वं तद्भोगेनैव जायते
उत्तरे प्रक्रमे शीघ्रा निशि मंदा गतिर्दिवा ॥
verses.rom:
dinaderdirghahrasvatvam tadbhogenaiva jayate
uttare prakrame shighra nishi mamda gatirdiva ||

verses.sa: दक्षिणे त्वयने चैव विपरीतां विवस्वतः ॥
verses.rom: dakshine tvayane chaiva viparitam vivasvatah ||

verses.sa:
उषा रात्रिः समाख्याताव्युष्टिश्चाप्युच्यते दिनम्
प्रोच्यते च तथा संध्या उषाव्युष्ट्योर्यदन्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
usha ratrih samakhyatavyushtishchapyuchyate dinam
prochyate cha tatha samdhya ushavyushtyoryadantaram ||

verses.sa:
संध्याकाले च संप्राप्ते रौद्रे परमदारुणे
मन्देहा राक्षसा घोराः सूर्यमिच्छिन्ति खादितुम् ॥
verses.rom:
samdhyakale cha samprapte raudre paramadarune
mandeha rakshasa ghorah suryamichchhinti khaditum ||

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिकृतः शापस्तेषां मैत्रेय रक्षसाम्
अक्षयत्वं शरीराणां मरणं च दिने दिने ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatikritah shapastesham maitreya rakshasam
akshayatvam shariranam maranam cha dine dine ||

verses.sa:
ततः सूर्यस्य तैर्युद्धं भवत्यत्यन्तदारुणम्
ततो द्विजोत्तमास्तोयं संक्षिपन्ति महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
tatah suryasya tairyuddham bhavatyatyantadarunam
tato dvijottamastoyam samkshipanti mahamune ||

verses.sa:
ॐकारब्रह्मसंयुक्तं गायत्र्! या चाभिमन्त्रितम्
तेन दह्यन्ति ते पापा वज्रीभूतेन वारिणा ॥
verses.rom:
omkarabrahmasamyuktam gayatr! ya chabhimantritam
tena dahyanti te papa vajribhutena varina ||

verses.sa:
अग्निहोत्रे हूयते या समन्त्रा प्रथमाहुतिः
सूर्योज्योतिः सहस्रांशु समा दीप्यति भास्करः ॥
verses.rom:
agnihotre huyate ya samantra prathamahutih
suryojyotih sahasramshu sama dipyati bhaskarah ||

verses.sa:
ॐकारो भगवान्विष्णुस्त्रिधामा वचसां पतिः
तदुच्चारणतस्ते तु विनाशं यांति राक्षसाः ॥
verses.rom:
omkaro bhagavanvishnustridhama vachasam patih
taduchcharanataste tu vinasham yamti rakshasah ||

verses.sa:
वैष्णुवॐशः परः सूर्यो योन्तर्ज्योतिरसंप्लवम्
अभियायक ॐकारस्तस्य तत्प्रेरकं परम् ॥
verses.rom:
vaishnuvaomshah parah suryo yontarjyotirasamplavam
abhiyayaka omkarastasya tatprerakam param ||

verses.sa:
तेन संप्रेरितं ज्योतिरॐकारेणाथ दीप्तिमत्
दहत्यश्षोरक्षांसि मन्देहाख्यान्यघानि वै ॥
verses.rom:
tena sampreritam jyotiraomkarenatha diptimat
dahatyashshorakshamsi mandehakhyanyaghani vai ||

verses.sa:
तस्मान्नोल्लंघनं कार्यं संध्योपासनकर्मणः
स हन्ति सूर्यं सन्ध्याया नोपास्तिं कुरुते तु यः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmannollamghanam karyam samdhyopasanakarmanah
sa hanti suryam sandhyaya nopastim kurute tu yah ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रयाति भगवान्ब्राह्मणैरभिरक्षितः
वालखिल्यादिभिश्चैव जगतः पालनोद्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prayati bhagavanbrahmanairabhirakshitah
valakhilyadibhishchaiva jagatah palanodyatah ||

verses.sa:
काष्ठा निमेषा दश पंच चैव त्रिंशच्च काष्ठा गणयेत्कलां च
त्रिंशत्कलश्चैव भवेन्मुहूर्तस्तैस्त्रिंशता रात्र्! यहनी समेते ॥
verses.rom:
kashtha nimesha dasha pamcha chaiva trimshachcha kashtha ganayetkalam cha
trimshatkalashchaiva bhavenmuhurtastaistrimshata ratr! yahani samete ||

verses.sa:
ह्रासवृद्धी त्वहर्भागैर्दिवसानां यथाक्रमम्
सन्ध्यामुहूर्त्तमात्रा वै ह्रासवृद्धौ समा स्मृता ॥
verses.rom:
hrasavriddhi tvaharbhagairdivasanam yathakramam
sandhyamuhurttamatra vai hrasavriddhau sama smrita ||

verses.sa:
रेखाप्रभृत्यथादित्ये त्रिमुहूर्त्तगते रवौ
प्रातः स्मृतस्ततः कालो भागश्चाह्नः स पञ्चमः ॥
verses.rom:
rekhaprabhrityathaditye trimuhurttagate ravau
pratah smritastatah kalo bhagashchahnah sa panchamah ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात्प्रातस्तनात्कालात्त्रिमुहूर्त्तस्तु सङ्गवः
मध्याह्नस्त्रिमुहूर्त्तस्तु तस्मात्कालात्तु सङ्गवात् ॥
verses.rom:
tasmatpratastanatkalattrimuhurttastu sangavah
madhyahnastrimuhurttastu tasmatkalattu sangavat ||

verses.sa:
तस्मान्माध्याह्निकात्कालादपराह्ण इति स्मृतः
त्रय एव मुहूर्त्तास्तु कालभागः स्मृतो बुधैः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmanmadhyahnikatkaladaparahna iti smritah
traya eva muhurttastu kalabhagah smrito budhaih ||

verses.sa:
आपराह्णे व्यतीते तु कालः सायाह्न एव च
दशपञ्च मुहूर्तं वै मुहूर्तास्त्रय एव च ॥
verses.rom:
aparahne vyatite tu kalah sayahna eva cha
dashapancha muhurtam vai muhurtastraya eva cha ||

verses.sa: दशपंच मुहूर्तं वै अहर्वैषुवतं स्मृतम् ॥
verses.rom: dashapamcha muhurtam vai aharvaishuvatam smritam ||

verses.sa:
वर्द्धते ह्रसेत चैवाप्ययने दक्षिणोत्तरे
अहस्तु ग्रसते रात्रिं रात्रिर्ग्रसति वासरम् ॥
verses.rom:
varddhate hraseta chaivapyayane dakshinottare
ahastu grasate ratrim ratrirgrasati vasaram ||

verses.sa:
शरद्वसन्तयोर्मध्ये विषुवं तु विभाव्यते
तुलामेषगते भानौ समरात्रिदिनं तु तत् ॥
verses.rom:
sharadvasantayormadhye vishuvam tu vibhavyate
tulameshagate bhanau samaratridinam tu tat ||

verses.sa:
कर्कटावस्थिते भानौ दक्षिणायनमुच्यते
उत्तरायणमप्युक्तं मकरस्थे दिवाकरे ॥
verses.rom:
karkatavasthite bhanau dakshinayanamuchyate
uttarayanamapyuktam makarasthe divakare ||

verses.sa:
त्रिंशन्मुहूर्तं कथितमहोरात्रं तु यन्मया
तानि पंचदश ब्रह्मन् पक्ष इत्यभिधीयते ॥
verses.rom:
trimshanmuhurtam kathitamahoratram tu yanmaya
tani pamchadasha brahman paksha ityabhidhiyate ||

verses.sa:
मासः पक्षद्वयेनोक्तो द्वौ मासौ चार्कजावृतुः
ऋतुत्रयं चाप्ययनं द्वेऽयने वर्षसंज्ञिते ॥
verses.rom:
masah pakshadvayenokto dvau masau charkajavrituh
ritutrayam chapyayanam dve'yane varshasamjnite ||

verses.sa:
संवत्सरादयः पंच चतुर्मासविकल्पिताः
निश्चयः सर्वकालस्य युगमित्यभिधीयते ॥
verses.rom:
samvatsaradayah pamcha chaturmasavikalpitah
nishchayah sarvakalasya yugamityabhidhiyate ||

verses.sa:
संवत्सरस्तु प्रथमो द्वितीयः परिवत्सरः
इद्वत्सरस्तृतीयस्तु चतुर्थश्चानुवत्सरः
वत्सरः पंचमश्चात्र कालोयं युगसंज्ञितः ॥
verses.rom:
samvatsarastu prathamo dvitiyah parivatsarah
idvatsarastritiyastu chaturthashchanuvatsarah
vatsarah pamchamashchatra kaloyam yugasamjnitah ||

verses.sa:
यः श्वेतस्योत्तरः शैलः शृङ्गवानिति विश्रुतः
त्रीणि तस्य तु शृंगाणि मैरयं शृगवान्स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
yah shvetasyottarah shailah shringavaniti vishrutah
trini tasya tu shrimgani mairayam shrigavansmritah ||

verses.sa:
दक्षिणं चोत्तरं चैव मध्यं वैषुवतं तथा
शरद्वसंतयोर्मध्ये तद्भानुः प्रतिपद्यते
मेषादौ च तुलादौ च मैत्रेय विषुवं स्मृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
dakshinam chottaram chaiva madhyam vaishuvatam tatha
sharadvasamtayormadhye tadbhanuh pratipadyate
meshadau cha tuladau cha maitreya vishuvam smritam ||

verses.sa:
तदा तुल्यमहोरात्रं करोति तिमिरापहः
दशपञ्च मुहूर्तं वै तदेतदुभयं स्मृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tada tulyamahoratram karoti timirapahah
dashapancha muhurtam vai tadetadubhayam smritam ||

verses.sa:
प्रथमे कृत्तिकाभागे यदा भास्वांस्तदा शशी
विशाखानां चतुर्थेंशो! मुने तिष्ठत्यसंशयम् ॥
verses.rom:
prathame krittikabhage yada bhasvamstada shashi
vishakhanam chaturthemsho! mune tishthatyasamshayam ||

verses.sa:
विशाखानां यदा सूर्यश्चरत्यंशं तृतीयकम्
तदा चन्द्रं विजानीयात्कृत्तिकाशिरसि स्थितम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishakhanam yada suryashcharatyamsham tritiyakam
tada chandram vijaniyatkrittikashirasi sthitam ||

verses.sa:
तदैव विषुवाख्योऽयं कालः पुण्योऽभिधीयते
तदा दानादि देयानि देवेभ्यः प्रयतात्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tadaiva vishuvakhyo'yam kalah punyo'bhidhiyate
tada danadi deyani devebhyah prayatatmabhih ||

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च मुखमेतत्तु दानजम्
दत्तदानस्तु विषुवे कृतकृत्योभिजायते ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanebhyah pitribhyashcha mukhametattu danajam
dattadanastu vishuve kritakrityobhijayate ||

verses.sa:
अहोरात्रार्द्धमासा तु कलाः काष्ठाः क्षणास्तथा
पौर्णमासी तथा ज्ञेया अमावास्या तथैव च
सिनीवाली कुहूश्चैव एका चानुमतिस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
ahoratrarddhamasa tu kalah kashthah kshanastatha
paurnamasi tatha jneya amavasya tathaiva cha
sinivali kuhushchaiva eka chanumatistatha ||

verses.sa:
तपस्तपस्यौ मधुमाधवौ च शुक्रः शुचिश्चायनमुत्तरं स्यात्
नभोनभस्यौ च इषस्तथोर्जस्सहःसहस्याविति दक्षिणं तत् ॥
verses.rom:
tapastapasyau madhumadhavau cha shukrah shuchishchayanamuttaram syat
nabhonabhasyau cha ishastathorjassahahsahasyaviti dakshinam tat ||

verses.sa:
लोका लोकश्च यश्शैलः प्रागुक्तो भवतो मया
लोकपालास्तु चत्वारस्तत्र तिष्ठन्ति सुव्रताः ॥
verses.rom:
loka lokashcha yashshailah pragukto bhavato maya
lokapalastu chatvarastatra tishthanti suvratah ||

verses.sa:
सुधामा शङ्खपाच्चैव कर्दमस्यात्मजौ द्विज
हिरण्यरोमा चैवान्यश्चतुर्थः केकुमानपि ॥
verses.rom:
sudhama shankhapachchaiva kardamasyatmajau dvija
hiranyaroma chaivanyashchaturthah kekumanapi ||

verses.sa:
निर्द्वन्द्वा निरभीमाना निस्तन्द्रा निष्परिग्रहाः
लोकपालाः स्थिता ह्येते लोकालोके चतुर्दिशम् ॥
verses.rom:
nirdvandva nirabhimana nistandra nishparigrahah
lokapalah sthita hyete lokaloke chaturdisham ||

verses.sa:
उत्तरं पदगस्त्यस्य अजवीथ्याश्च दक्षिणम्
पितृयानः स वै पन्था वैश्वानरपथाद्बहिः ॥
verses.rom:
uttaram padagastyasya ajavithyashcha dakshinam
pitriyanah sa vai pantha vaishvanarapathadbahih ||

verses.sa:
तत्रासते महात्मान ऋषयो येऽग्निहोत्रिणः
भूतारम्भकृतं ब्रह्म शंसन्तो ऋत्विगुद्यताः
प्रारभन्ते तु ये लोकास्तेषां पन्थाः स दक्षिणः ॥
verses.rom:
tatrasate mahatmana rishayo ye'gnihotrinah
bhutarambhakritam brahma shamsanto ritvigudyatah
prarabhante tu ye lokastesham panthah sa dakshinah ||

verses.sa:
चलितं ते पुनर्ब्रह्म स्थापयन्ति युगेयुगे
सन्तत्या तपसा चैव मर्यादाभिः श्रुतेन च ॥
verses.rom:
chalitam te punarbrahma sthapayanti yugeyuge
santatya tapasa chaiva maryadabhih shrutena cha ||

verses.sa:
जायमानास्तु पूर्वे च पश्चिमानां गृहेषु वै
पश्चिमाश्चैव पूर्वेषां जायन्ते विधनेष्विह ॥
verses.rom:
jayamanastu purve cha pashchimanam griheshu vai
pashchimashchaiva purvesham jayante vidhaneshviha ||

verses.sa:
एवमावर्त्तमानास्ते तिष्ठन्ति नियतव्रताः
सवितुर्दक्षिणं मार्गं श्रिता ह्याचन्द्र तारकम् ॥
verses.rom:
evamavarttamanaste tishthanti niyatavratah
saviturdakshinam margam shrita hyachandra tarakam ||

verses.sa:
नागावीथ्युत्तरं यच्च सप्तर्षिभ्यश्च दक्षिणम्
उत्तरः सवितुः पंथा देवयानश्च स स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
nagavithyuttaram yachcha saptarshibhyashcha dakshinam
uttarah savituh pamtha devayanashcha sa smritah ||

verses.sa:
तत्र ते वासिनः सिद्धा विमला ब्रह्मचारिणः
सन्ततिं ते जुगुप्संति तस्मान्मृत्युर्जितश्च तैः ॥
verses.rom:
tatra te vasinah siddha vimala brahmacharinah
santatim te jugupsamti tasmanmrityurjitashcha taih ||

verses.sa:
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि मुनीनामूर्ध्वरेतसाम्
उदक्पन्थनमर्यम्णः स्थिता ह्याभूतसंप्लवम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashtashitisahasrani muninamurdhvaretasam
udakpanthanamaryamnah sthita hyabhutasamplavam ||

verses.sa:
ते संप्रयोगाल्लोभस्य मैथुनस्य च वर्जनात्
इच्छाद्वेषाप्रवृत्त्या च भूतारम्भविवर्जनात् ॥
verses.rom:
te samprayogallobhasya maithunasya cha varjanat
ichchhadveshapravrittya cha bhutarambhavivarjanat ||

verses.sa:
पुनश्च कामासंयोगाच्छब्दादेर्दोषदर्शनात्
इत्येभिः कारणैः शुद्धास्तेमृतत्वं हि भेजिरे ॥
verses.rom:
punashcha kamasamyogachchhabdaderdoshadarshanat
ityebhih karanaih shuddhastemritatvam hi bhejire ||

verses.sa:
आभूतसंप्लवं स्थानममृतत्वं विभाव्यते
त्रैलोक्यस्थितिकालोयमपुनर्मार उच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
abhutasamplavam sthanamamritatvam vibhavyate
trailokyasthitikaloyamapunarmara uchyate ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्महत्याश्वमेधाभ्यां पापपुण्यकृतो विधिः
आभूतसंप्लवान्तन्तु फलमुक्तं तयोर्द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
brahmahatyashvamedhabhyam papapunyakrito vidhih
abhutasamplavantantu phalamuktam tayordvija ||

verses.sa:
यावन्मात्रे प्रदेशो! तु मैत्रेयावस्थितो ध्रुवः
क्षयमायाति तावत्तु भूमेराभूतसंप्लवात् ॥
verses.rom:
yavanmatre pradesho! tu maitreyavasthito dhruvah
kshayamayati tavattu bhumerabhutasamplavat ||

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वोत्तरमृषिभ्यस्तु ध्रुवो यत्र व्यवस्थितः
एतद्विष्णुपदं दिव्यं तृतीयं व्योम्नि भासुरम् ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvottaramrishibhyastu dhruvo yatra vyavasthitah
etadvishnupadam divyam tritiyam vyomni bhasuram ||

verses.sa:
निर्धूतदोषपङ्कानां यतीनां संयतात्मनाम्
स्थानं तत्परमं विप्र पुण्यपापरिक्षये ॥
verses.rom:
nirdhutadoshapankanam yatinam samyatatmanam
sthanam tatparamam vipra punyapaparikshaye ||

verses.sa:
अपुण्यपुण्योपरमे क्षीणाशेषाप्तिहेतवः
यत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
apunyapunyoparame kshinasheshaptihetavah
yatra gatva na shochanti tadvishnoh paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
धर्मध्रुवाद्यास्तिष्ठन्ति यत्र ते लोकसाक्षिणः
तत्सार्ष्ट्योत्पन्नयोगर्धिस्तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
dharmadhruvadyastishthanti yatra te lokasakshinah
tatsarshtyotpannayogardhistadvishnoh paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
यत्रोतमेतत्प्रोतं च यद्भूतं सचराचरम्
भाव्यं य विश्वं मैत्रेय तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatrotametatprotam cha yadbhutam sacharacharam
bhavyam ya vishvam maitreya tadvishnoh paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
दिवीव चक्षुराततं योगिनां तन्मयात्मनाम्
विवेकज्ञानदृष्टं च तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
diviva chakshuratatam yoginam tanmayatmanam
vivekajnanadrishtam cha tadvishnoh paramam padam ||

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्प्रतिष्ठितो भास्वान्मेढीभूतः स्वयं ध्रुवः
ध्रुवे च सर्वज्योतींषि ज्योतिष्वम्भोमुचो द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
yasminpratishthito bhasvanmedhibhutah svayam dhruvah
dhruve cha sarvajyotimshi jyotishvambhomucho dvija ||

verses.sa:
मेघेषु संगता वृष्टिर्वृष्टेः सृष्टेश्च पोषणम्
आप्यायनं च सर्वेषां देवादीनां महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
megheshu samgata vrishtirvrishteh srishteshcha poshanam
apyayanam cha sarvesham devadinam mahamune ||

verses.sa:
ततश्चाज्याहुतिद्वारा पोषितास्ते हविर्भुजः
वृष्टेः कारणतां यांति भूतानां स्थितये पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchajyahutidvara poshitaste havirbhujah
vrishteh karanatam yamti bhutanam sthitaye punah ||

verses.sa:
एवमेतत्पदं विष्णोस्तृतीयममलात्मकम्
आधारभूतं लोकानां त्रयाणां वृष्टिकारणम् ॥
verses.rom:
evametatpadam vishnostritiyamamalatmakam
adharabhutam lokanam trayanam vrishtikaranam ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रभवति ब्रह्मन्सर्वपापहरा सरित्
गंगा देवांगनांगानामनुलेपनपिञ्जरा ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prabhavati brahmansarvapapahara sarit
gamga devamganamganamanulepanapinjara ||

verses.sa:
वामपादाम्बुजांगुष्ठनखस्रोतोविनिर्गताम्
विष्णोर्बिभर्त्ति यां भक्त्या शिरसाहर्निशं ध्रुवः ॥
verses.rom:
vamapadambujamgushthanakhasrotovinirgatam
vishnorbibhartti yam bhaktya shirasaharnisham dhruvah ||

verses.sa:
ततः सप्तर्षयो यस्याः प्राणायामपरायणाः
तिष्ठन्ति वीचिमालाभिरुह्यमानजटाजले ॥
verses.rom:
tatah saptarshayo yasyah pranayamaparayanah
tishthanti vichimalabhiruhyamanajatajale ||

verses.sa:
वार्योघैः संततैर्यस्याः प्लावितं शशिमण्डलम्
भूयोधिकतरां कांतिं वहत्येतदुह क्षये ॥
verses.rom:
varyoghaih samtatairyasyah plavitam shashimandalam
bhuyodhikataram kamtim vahatyetaduha kshaye ||

verses.sa:
मेरुपृष्टे पतत्युच्चैर्निष्क्रांता शशिमण्डलात्
जगतः पावनार्थाय प्रयाति च चतुर्दिशम् ॥
verses.rom:
meruprishte patatyuchchairnishkramta shashimandalat
jagatah pavanarthaya prayati cha chaturdisham ||

verses.sa:
सीता चालकनन्दा च चक्षुर्भद्रा च संस्थिता
एकैव या चतुर्भेदा दिग्भेदगतिलक्षणा ॥
verses.rom:
sita chalakananda cha chakshurbhadra cha samsthita
ekaiva ya chaturbheda digbhedagatilakshana ||

verses.sa:
भेदं चालकनन्दाख्यं यस्याः शर्वोपि दक्षिणाम्
दधार शिरसा प्रीत्या वर्षाणामधिकं शतम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhedam chalakanandakhyam yasyah sharvopi dakshinam
dadhara shirasa pritya varshanamadhikam shatam ||

verses.sa:
शम्भोर्जटाकलापाच्च विनिष्क्रान्तास्थिशर्कराः
प्लावयित्वा दिवं निन्ये या पापान्सगरात्मजान् ॥
verses.rom:
shambhorjatakalapachcha vinishkrantasthisharkarah
plavayitva divam ninye ya papansagaratmajan ||

verses.sa:
स्नातस्य सलिले यस्याः सद्यः पापं प्रणश्यति
अपूर्वपुण्यप्राप्तिश्च सद्यो मैत्रेय जायते ॥
verses.rom:
snatasya salile yasyah sadyah papam pranashyati
apurvapunyapraptishcha sadyo maitreya jayate ||

verses.sa:
दत्ताः पितृभ्यो यत्रापस्तनयैः श्रद्धयान्वितैः
समाशतं प्रयच्छंति तृप्तिं मैत्रेय दुर्लभाम् ॥
verses.rom:
dattah pitribhyo yatrapastanayaih shraddhayanvitaih
samashatam prayachchhamti triptim maitreya durlabham ||

verses.sa:
यस्यामिष्ट्वा महायज्ञैर्यज्ञेशं पुरुषोत्तमम्
द्विज भूपाः परां सिद्धिमवापुर्दिवि चेह च ॥
verses.rom:
yasyamishtva mahayajnairyajnesham purushottamam
dvija bhupah param siddhimavapurdivi cheha cha ||

verses.sa:
स्नानाद्विधूतपापाश्च यज्जलैर्यतयस्तथा
केशवासक्तमनसः प्राप्ता निर्वाणमुत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
snanadvidhutapapashcha yajjalairyatayastatha
keshavasaktamanasah prapta nirvanamuttamam ||

verses.sa:
श्रुताऽभिलषिता दृष्टा स्पृष्टा पीताऽवगाहिता
या पावयति भूतानि कीर्तिता च दिनेदिने ॥
verses.rom:
shruta'bhilashita drishta sprishta pita'vagahita
ya pavayati bhutani kirtita cha dinedine ||

verses.sa:
गंगागंगेति यैर्नाम योजनानां शतष्वपि
स्थितैरुच्चारितं हन्ति पापं जन्मत्रयार्जितम् ॥
verses.rom:
gamgagamgeti yairnama yojananam shatashvapi
sthitairuchcharitam hanti papam janmatrayarjitam ||

verses.sa:
यतः सा पावनायालं त्रयाणां जगतामपि
समुद्भूता परं तत्तु तृतीयं भगवत्पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatah sa pavanayalam trayanam jagatamapi
samudbhuta param tattu tritiyam bhagavatpadam ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे द्वितीयेंशो!ऽष्टमोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane dvitiyemsho!'shtamo'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—I have described to you the system of the universe in general: I shall now describe the situations and dimensions of the sun and other luminaries.

O foremost of Munis, the chariot of the sun is nine thousand leagues in length and the pole is of twice that size; the axle is more than fifteen millions and seven hundred thousand yojanas long, on which a wheel is placed with three naves, five spokes and six peripheries. It is undecaying and continues for the year and consequently all the cycles of the time are placed herein. The second axle of his chariot is forty five thousand, five hundred leagues long. O thou of great mind, the two halves of the yoke are respectively as long as two axles. The short axle and the short yoke are supported by pole star: the end of the longer axle to which is fixed the wheel is situate on Manasa mountain. The seven steeds which draw the sun's car are the metres of the Vedas Gāyatri, Vrihati, Ushnih, Jayati, Tristubh, Anustubh and Pankti.

The city of Vāsava is situated on the eastern side of the Mānosottara mountain, on its southern side is the city of wealth, on its western side is the city of Varuna and on the northern side is the city of Soma. I shall relate the names of those cities; do thou hear them. The city of Sakra is named Vaswoksārā, that of Yama is called Samyamani; that of Varuna is named Mukhyā and that of Soma Vibhāvari.

O Maitreya, the glorious sun moves speedily like a dart on his southern course attended by the constellations of the Zodiac; He creates day and night and is the divine path of the sages who have got over the worldly afflictions.

O Maitreya, while in one insular continent the sun shines in midday, in the opposite Dwipas it will be midnight; rising and setting thus take place at all seasons and are always opposed in the different cardinal and intermediate points of horizon. Wherever the sun is visible he is said to rise there and wherever he disappears from view he is said to be set. In sooth, their is neither rising nor setting of the sun; for he always exists; the appearance and disappearance of the sun are merely called rising and setting.

When the sun is in the cities of Sakra and others, the three cities and two intermediate points are illuminated; and when he is in an intermediate point he extends light to the two cities and three intermediate points. From the time of his rising till midday the rays of the sun gradually increase; and from then he moves towards setting with his diminishing rays. By the rising and the setting of the sun the east and west quarters are ascertained. As far as the sun shines in front so far he shines behind, and thus on both the sides illuminating all the places except the court of Brahmā which is situate on the summit of Meru—the mountain of the celestials. When the rays of the sun reach the court of Brahmā they are repelled and driven back by the radiance which prevails there. Consequently there is the alternation of day and night in northern quarter in as much as all the insular continents are situated on the north of Meru.

The radiance of the sun, after its setting, is deposited in fire and hence fire is visible even at a greater distance in night. During day the rays of fire enter into the sun by virtue of which the sun becomes more brilliant. Elemental light and heat, proceeding respectively from the sun and fire and mixing with each other, prevail in diverse degrees both by day and night. When the sun prevails either in the northern or southern hemisphere day or night goes into waters according as they are attacked by darkness or light; it is for this reason that waters appear dark by day because night is within them and white by night because when the sun is set the light of the day enters therein.

When the sun goes to Pushkara Dwipa, a thirtieth part of the circumference of the globe, his course is equal in time to one Muhurtta; and whirling round like the circumference of the wheel of a potter he alternately spreads day and night on the surface of the earth. At the beginning of his northern course the sun passes to Capricornus, thence to Aquarias, thence to Pisces, successively passing from one sign of the Zodiac to another. After he has gone through them the sun gets at the vernal equinox when he makes the day and night of equal duration. From then the length of the night decreases and the day grows longer until the sun reaches the end of Gemini when he follows a different course and entering Cancer begins his declension to the south. The sun moves quickly on his southern course like the circumference of a potter's wheel revolving respectively. He glides along his course with the velocity of the wind and traverses a great distance in a short time. In twelve Muhurttas it goes through thirteen lunar asterisms and a half during the day, and during the night, it goes through the same distance only in eighteen Muhurttas. As the centre of the potter's wheel revolves more slowly than the circumference so the sun in his northern course revolves with less rapidity and passes over a less space of the earth in a longer time, until at the end of his northern route the day is again eighteen Muhurttas long and the night twelve the sun passing through them by day and night respectively in those periods. As the lump of the clay on the centre of the potter's wheel revolves most slowly, so the polar star, which is the centre of the Zodiacal wheel, moves very slowly and always remains in the centre like the clay. The relative length of the day or night is dependant upon the greater or less motion with which the sun revolves through the degrees between the two points of horizon. During the midday when his diurnal course is quickest his nocturnal is slowest and when he moves quickly by night he moves slowly by day. The length of his journey in both the cases is the same; for during the day and night he travels through all the signs of the Zodiac or six by night and six by day. The length and shortness of the day are measured by the extent of the signs; and the duration of day and night is measured by the period which the sun takes to pass through them. When he declines towards the north the sun moves quickest by night and slowest by day and when he declines towards the south the case is thoroughly the reverse.

The night is called Ushā and the day is called Vyushta and the intervening time between them is called Sandhyā. When the dreadful Sandhya sets in, the awful Rākshasas named Mandehas attempt to devour the sun. O Maitreya, the Patriarch Brahmā imprecated this curse upon them that they should perish by day and revive at other times. For this reason a fierce contest takes place daily between them and the sun. At this time, O great Muni, the pious Brahmins scatter water purified by the mystical Omkāra and consecrated by the Gayatri and by means of this water as by a thunder-bolt the dreadful Rākshasas are destroyed. While during the course of morning rites the first oblation is offered with solemn invocations, the sun, having thousand rays, appears with unclouded splendour. Omkāra is the glorious Vishnu, the essence of the three Vedas, the lord of speech; and by its mention the Rākshasas are slain. The sun is a principal portion of Vishnu and light is his immutable essence, the manifestation of which is made by the mystic syllable Om. Light, spread by the utterance of Omkāra, becomes radiant and burns up completely the Rākshasas denominated as Mandebas. Therefore one should not be dilatory in the performance of Sandhyā sacrifice; for he, who neglects it, is guilty of the murder of the sun. Being thus protected by the Brahmanas called Bālakhilyas the sun proceeds to protect the world.

Fifteen Nimeshas (twinkling of the eye) make a Kāshthā; thirty Kāshthās make one Kalā; thirty Kalās a Muhurtta and thirty Muhurttas a day and night; the divisions of the day become longer or shorter in the way explained before. But as regards increase or decrease Sandhyā is always the same for it is only one Muhurtta. From the time when half of the sun's orb is visible to the expiration of three Muhurttas the interval is called Prātar (morning) forming a fifth portion of the day. The next portion or three Muhurttas from morning is called Sangava (forenoon); the three next Muhurttas make the midday; the three next Muhurttas constitute the afternoon; the three next Muhurttas make the evening; and thus the fifteen Muhurttas of the day are divided into five portions of three each. But the day comprises fifteen Muhurttas only at the Equinoxes and increases and diminishes in number as the sun declines towards the north or the south, when the day encroaches upon the night and the night upon the day. The equinoxes take place during the spring and autumn when the sun enters the signs of Aries and Libra. When the sun enters Capricorn his progress towards the north begins and when he enters Cancer his progress towards the south commences. Fifteen days of thirty Muharttas each are called a Paksha (fortnight); two fortnights make one month and two months a solar season and three seasons make one Ayana (a northern or southern declination) and two Ayanas make one year. Years are made up of four kinds of months and five years make one Yuga or cycle. The years are respectively called Samvatsara, Parivatsara, Idvatsara, Anuvatsara and Vatsara. This is the time called a Yuga.

The mountain that is situate in the north of Bhāratvarsa is called Sringavān for its having three principal horns or peaks, one to the north, one to the south and one in the centre. The last is called equinoctial for the sun goes there in the middle of the two seasons of spring and autumn, arriving at the equinoctical points in the first degrees of Aries and Libra and making day and night of equal duration of fifteen Muhurttas each.
